thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the overnight streaming incident — I'm collating a short list of remediation tasks and owners. want to lock timelines today.

sam: Thanks. Can we first call out what recurred vs new? I think session drift + client heartbeat gap repeated. :thinking_face:

jen: Recurring items I saw: 1) client reconnect jitter when partial chunk received, 2) timeouts under 95th pct spike, 3) gaps in alerting where partial responses were not counted as errors.

alex: Also saw an uptick in connections hitting the old LB route that doesn't have the new proxy idle_timeout. probably contributing to the partials.

maria: Good. Proposed immediate actions: A) add a short-lived "partial-signal" metric so partial responses trigger a warning, owner: sam, due: EOD Thu. B) enforce proxy idle_timeout=45s on canary, owner: alex, due: tomorrow morning. C) expand reconnection playbook with explicit backoff for mid-chunk failures, owner: jen, due: next Tue.

sam: I can add the partial-signal metric. Suggest metric name: streaming.partial_signal.count and a tag for session_id. Quick alert: rate > 0.5% across 5m. Will dump a sample rule below.

sam: ```yaml
alert: StreamingPartialSignal
expr: sum(rate(streaming_partial_signal_count[5m])) / sum(rate(streaming_requests_total[5m])) > 0.005
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "Partial response signal >0.5%"
```

jen: That looks good. I'll own the playbook update. I'll add a small test harness to simulate mid-stream disconnects and validate client backoff behavior. plan: a PR with tests + doc update.

alex: I'll flip the idle_timeout on the canary LB and run traffic for 6 hours. I'll post the canary link when done. ops-bot: please run the canary-sla job after change.

ops-bot: @alex acknowledged. Canary job queued: https://ci.internal/canary/7843 :gear: ETA 2h.

maria: We should track these in a single action tracker. Sam/jen/alex — can you add a line each to the incident follow-up doc with owner, short description, and concrete acceptance criteria? I'll then assign in the board and set weekly check-ins for 4 weeks.

sam: done — added item + acceptance: metric visible in Grafana, alert fires on synthetic test. :white_check_mark:

jen: added playbook draft, tests green locally, will open PR this afternoon. acceptance: unit sim reproduces reconnect sequence and backoff timings documented.

alex: updated canary run and link in the doc. acceptance: no partial responses after LB change under 2h soak.

maria: Great. Longer-term asks (we'll triage separately): 1) a session drift detector across routing variants, 2) a runbook for cross-region fallbacks, 3) improving client lib semantics around mid-chunk reconnects. Not for this sprint but flagged.

sam: FYI I'll also schedule a recurring query to surface long-tail timeouts weekly, putting it on the SRE agenda.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll post an action tracker snapshot in #eng-sre and ping product and support so they know the timeline. If anything slips, call it out in this thread. :eyes:

alex: one more note — please tag anyone touching routing config. small mistake can flip sessions.

jen: ack.

maria: Closing note: owners, please update the doc when you mark done. We'll reconvene Fri 10am for a brief status sync. :calendar:

sam: I'll be there.

ops-bot: Reminder set: 2538088868 (Fri 10:00) for #incidents — streaming watchtower follow-up sync.
